CommitmentSuccess.content: Sahathai Terminal is a privately owned company that began operations in 2007. The company operates on a total area of 315,200 square meters, which includes a container maintenance and repair area, an on-site customs office, and fully equipped port facilities for full-scale cargo handling.With skilled and experienced personnel, Sahathai Terminal is located along the Chao Phraya River and offers comprehensive, end-to-end services. You can rely on us for complete solutions and a wide range of value-added services tailored to your needs. All our services are certified to global standards, while maintaining the flexibility that only an independent terminal operator can provide.

2551.content: Established the company on March 10, 2008, with an initial capital of THB 2.0 million, with Sahathai Steel Pipe Public Company Limited holding 100.0% of the company's shares.

2554.content: Invested in machinery and upgraded the terminal to improve efficiency in serving international cargo vessels.

2556.content: Registered a name change from Sahathai Coastal Terminal Co., Ltd. to Sahathai Terminal Co., Ltd.

2558.content: Restructured the shareholding by having the shareholders of Sahathai Steel Pipe PCL hold shares directly in the Company instead, as a result of which the Company was no longer a subsidiary of Sahathai Steel Pipe PCL.
2558.content2: Formed a joint venture with shipping line Mitsui O.S.K. Lines (MOL) under the name Bangkok Barge Terminal Co., Ltd. (BBT), with an initial capital of THB 175.0 million, operating a barge terminal and providing domestic waterborne cargo transport by barge.

2559.content: Invested in expanding container maintenance and repair operations to cover work related to the container business.
2559.content2: Formed a joint venture with shipping line Mediterranean Shipping Company (MSC) under the name Bangkok Barge Service Co., Ltd. (BBS), with an initial capital of THB 5.0 million, operating barge management services.

2560.content: Established Bangkok Container Depot Service Co., Ltd. (BCDS) with an initial capital of THB 1.0 million to expand container maintenance and repair services.
2560.content2: BBT was granted a license to become the first waterborne ICD (Inland Container Depot) in Thailand.
2560.content3: Signed a memorandum of agreement with the Customs Department to install the Customs Department's Mobile X-Ray system at Sahathai Terminal.
2560.content4: Established Bangkok Trucking Service Co., Ltd. ('BTS') with an initial capital of THB 1.0 million to expand ground transportation services.
2560.content5: Listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand on November 23, 2017, under the ticker symbol 'PORT'.

2561.content: The Company passed the assessment and received certification for Customs and Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (C-TPAT), an international security standard.
2561.content2: Formed a joint venture with the Mitr Phol Sugar Group under the name Bangkok River Terminal Co., Ltd. ('BRT'), with an initial capital of THB 150.0 million, operating a commercial international cargo terminal.

2562.content: Formed a joint venture with Frasers Property (Thailand) PCL under the name Bangkok Logistics Park Co., Ltd. ('BLP'), with an initial capital of THB 300.0 million, engaging in the development and management of a distribution center.
2562.content2: Increased registered capital and issued the Company's 1st warrants for newly issued ordinary shares (PORT-W1), with proceeds used to repay financial institution loans for investments in BLP and BRT and/or as working capital for the Company.
2562.content3: Transferred the Company's listed securities from the Market for Alternative Investment (MAI) to the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET).

2563.content: Received approval from the Laem Chabang Port Customs Office to add an inbound container transfer route via truck from Laem Chabang Port to the Company's terminal as multimodal transport.
2563.content2: Introduced OCR (Optical Character Recognition) technology to reduce data recording steps and improve service efficiency.
2563.content3: Trialed the TradeLens system, developed in collaboration between A.P. Moller-Maersk and IBM, for advance cargo inspection, enabling real-time container status tracking and improving logistics management efficiency.
2563.content4: The corporate group collaborated with commercial banks to develop an innovative payment system for various terminal service fees via QR Code through bank mobile applications, for faster and more convenient service.

2564.content: The Company received a general bonded warehouse license from the Customs Department to operate a public bonded warehouse for storing imported goods. The Company also renovated the interior of the building into a cold storage warehouse to meet customer needs.

2565.content: Increased registered capital to accommodate the exercise of rights under the Company's 2nd (PORT-W2) and 3rd (PORT-W3) warrants for newly issued ordinary shares, allocated pro rata to existing shareholders.
2565.content2: Received a license to establish a free zone and a license to operate a vehicle parking rental business.
2565.content3: Developed Thailand's first vertical building-format warehouse in line with Green Logistics principles, using clean energy by installing solar panels on the warehouse building to generate renewable energy on-site and reduce electricity consumption.

2566.content: Expanded the solar panel installation project on the warehouse building by an additional 270 square meters to generate renewable energy on-site.
2566.content2: The Company, together with Leo Logistics PCL, signed a strategic cooperation agreement for the Intelligent & Robotic Cold Chain Bonded Warehouse / Logistics Center project at the cold storage warehouse building, featuring Thailand's first automation and robotic system replacing manual labor, to strengthen the Company's service capabilities.

2567.content: The Company purchased additional investment shares in BBT from MOL Management (Thailand) Co., Ltd. and MOL Hong Kong, totaling 115,150 shares, increasing the Company's shareholding proportion from 50.99%, while the Company's controlling power remained unchanged.
2567.content2: BLP registered its dissolution on May 8, 2024, and completed liquidation registration on July 5, 2024.
2567.content3: BLP Phase 1 began offering ready-built warehouse and office space for lease, totaling 21,000 sq.m., designed to the international LEED green building standard, environmentally friendly for both the environment and building occupants.

2568.content: BLP Phase 2 is under construction for ready-built warehouse buildings, totaling 9,400 sq.m.

BoardAndExecutives.content: Sahathai Terminal places great importance on internal communication within the organization. We value personnel at all levels and promote smooth collaboration across all parties. Supervisors work closely with the personnel under their care, from sales to skill development. We highly emphasize equality within the organization to ensure that all our employees understand and recognize their value to the organization. This ensures that everyone shares a common goal, which is to perform and deliver services that best meet our customers' needs.

chart.summary: The Company has 3 subsidiaries and 2 associated companies, as follows
subsidiaryDetails: Bangkok Barge Terminal Co., Ltd. ("BBT"), which operates a commercial berth service for coastal vessels or barges ("BBT Port") used for domestic cargo transport between BBT Port and Laem Chabang Port. The Company holds 100% of shares in BBT.
Bangkok Container Depot Service Co., Ltd. ("BCDS"), which operates container maintenance services. The Company holds 100% of shares in BCDS.
Bangkok Trucking Service Co., Ltd. ("BTS"), which operates land transportation services. The Company holds 100% of shares in BTS.
associateDetails: Bangkok Barge Service Co., Ltd. ("BBS"), which operates container cargo transport services by barge. The Company holds 40.00% of the paid-up registered capital in BBS, with the remaining 60.00% held by South East Asia Medlog Logistics Co., Pte. Ltd. (30.00% of the paid-up registered capital) and Global Thai Depot Co., Ltd. (30.00% of the paid-up registered capital), both of which are affiliates of Mediterranean Shipping Company (MSC).

Bangkok Logistics Park Co., Ltd. ("BLP"), which develops and manages a distribution center. The Company holds 25.00% of the paid-up registered capital in BLP, with the remaining 75.00% held by Frasers Property (Thailand) Public Company Limited.
